tasks.name: Set Up Tutorials and Hints Database

tasks.description: Test all frontend components for usability and bugs.

tasks.name: Perform Backend Testing
tasks.description: Test all backend components for functionality and performance.

tasks.description: Deploy the ACM Problem-Solving Platform to a production environment.

T1.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly interface for browsing, searching, and filtering problems.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle problem creation, retrieval, updates, and deletion.
T2.notes: Focus on scalability and secure endpoints.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a relational database schema to store problem details and metadata.
T3.notes: Optimize for query performance and data integrity.

T4.implementation_approach: Design an intuitive interface for users to submit code and view results.
T4.notes: Include syntax highlighting and error feedback.

T5.implementation_approach: Build backend logic to handle code submissions, execute them securely, and return results.
T5.notes: Implement sandboxing to prevent malicious code execution.

T6.implementation_approach: Create a database schema to store code submissions and their results.
T6.notes: Ensure proper indexing for quick retrieval.

T7.implementation_approach: Design a leaderboard UI to display user rankings and scores dynamically.

T8.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to calculate and serve leaderboard data based on user performance.

T9.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store user scores and ranking data.
T9.notes: Ensure data consistency and efficient aggregation.

T10.implementation_approach: Create a profile page UI for users to view and edit their information and activity.
T10.notes: Include sections for achievements and statistics.

T11.implementation_approach: Develop backend services to manage user profile data and authentication.
T11.notes: Ensure secure handling of sensitive user information.

T12.implementation_approach: Design a database schema to store user profile details and activity logs.

T13.implementation_approach: Design a UI to display tutorials and hints in an organized and accessible manner.
T13.notes: Support multimedia content like videos and images.

T14.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage tutorials and hints, including CRUD operations.
T14.notes: Ensure proper categorization and tagging for easy retrieval.

T15.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store tutorial and hint content with metadata.

T16.implementation_approach: Perform unit and integration testing for all frontend components using tools like Jest or Cypress.

T17.implementation_approach: Test backend APIs for functionality, performance, and security using tools like Postman or JMeter.
T17.notes: Include edge case and stress testing.

T18.implementation_approach: Validate database schema, queries, and data integrity through automated and manual testing.

T19.implementation_approach: Deploy the application using a cloud platform like AWS or Azure with CI/CD pipelines.
T19.notes: Ensure proper monitoring and logging are in place.
